Based on the screenshot provided, here is the **EXTREME DETAILED** description:

### 1. Dialog/Modal Status
**There is NO dialog or modal currently open.** The image shows the main page view of the "Program & Kegiatan" (Programs & Activities) section. The user is viewing the list of programs, not an input form or upload window.

### 2. Fields Shown (Main Page Context)
Since no modal is open, the visible "fields" are the data columns and summary cards on the main page:
*   **Summary Cards:**
    *   **Direncanakan (Planned):** 55 (Yellow background)
    *   **Berjalan (Ongoing):** 1 (Blue background)
    *   **Selesai (Completed):** 4 (Green background)
    *   **Ditunda (Postponed):** 0 (Red/Pink background)
*   **List Item Fields (for each program entry):**
    *   **Icon:** Blue document icon labeled "Dokumen Program"
    *   **Title:** e.g., "Mekanisme pelaksanaan, monitoring, dan evaluasi program"
    *   **Description/Tags:** e.g., "Struktur tanggung jawab pelaksanaan...", "DIRENCANAKAN" badge
    *   **Action Button:** "Bukti (0)" (Evidence) button in light green/teal
    *   **Row Actions:** Edit (pencil icon) and Delete (trash icon) buttons on the right

### 3. Preview PDF Section
**No.** There is no 'Preview PDF' section visible because no document is being viewed or uploaded in a modal. The page only shows a list of program titles.

### 4. Buttons at the Bottom of the Page
(These are page-level action buttons, not modal buttons):
*   **Upload PDF:** White button with upload icon and text "Upload PDF" (located top-right of the content area)
*   **Tambah Program:** Blue button with plus icon and text "Tambah Program" (Add Program) (located top-right next to Upload PDF)
*   **Kembali:** Text link with left arrow "< Kembali" (Back) located above the program list title

### 5. Dialog Type Identification
This is **neither** an 'Upload PDF' nor an 'Edit/Tambah Program' dialog. This is the **main index/listing page** for "Program Kerja Nasional & Daerah — DPD Kalimantan Barat" (National & Regional Work Programs).

### 6. EVERY Visible UI Element (Top to Bottom)

**Browser Chrome:**
*   Tab title: "LAPRA 08 - Sistem Informasi Internal Global - Google Chrome"
*   Address bar: `lapra08.vercel.app`
*   Window controls (minimize, maximize, close)

**Sidebar (Left Navigation - Dark Theme):**
*   Logo area: Circular logo with "LAPRA 08" text and subtitle "PORTAL SISTEM INFORMASI"
*   Menu items:
    *   Beranda (Home) - with home icon
    *   Profil (Profile) - with user icon
    *   Pusat Media (Media Center) - with newspaper icon
    *   **Program & Kegiatan** (Active/Selected - Red background with white text) - with calendar icon
    *   Layanan & Advokasi (Services & Advocacy) - with shield icon
    *   Kontak & Sekretariat (Contact & Secretariat) - with building icon
*   **SISTEM ADMINISTRASI** (Section Header):

    *   Logistik & Atribut (Logistics & Attributes) - with cube icon
    *   Komunikasi & Broadcast - with share nodes icon
    *   Kas & Keuangan (Cash & Finance) - with wallet icon
    *   Pengaturan User (User Settings) - with users icon

**Top Header Bar (Dark Navy):**
*   Breadcrumb/Back arrow: `<`
*   Portal name: "PORTAL LAPRA 08"
*   Page Title: "**Program & Kegiatan**" (Bold, large)
*   Top-right badges:
    *   "Super Admin" (Pink/Red pill badge)
    *   "Dev Mode" (Yellow/Gold pill badge with bug icon)

**Alert Banner (Orange/Red gradient):**

**Main Content Area (White background):**

    *   Subheading: "Program kerja, aksi sosial, kemitraan, dan agenda kegiatan"
    
*   **Tab Navigation (Pill-shaped buttons):**

*   **Statistics Cards (4 cards in a row):**

Setiap langkah..." (truncated text)
        *   Badge: "DIRENCANAKAN" (Yellow background, black text)
        *   Button: "Bukti (0)" (Light teal/green background, checkmark icon, indicating 0 evidence files uploaded)

*   **Program List (Card 2 - Partially visible):**
    *   Similar structure as Card 1
    *   Title starts: "Tujuan, strategi, dan arah kebijakan program kerja"
    *   Description truncated: "• Rencana kerja tahunan dan lima tahunan DPD • Mekanisme pelaksanaan, monitoring, dan evaluasi program • Struktur tanggung jawab pelaksanaan..."

**Windows Taskbar (Bottom):**
*   Search bar: "Search" with magnifying glass
*   Pinned icons: Edge, File Explorer, Google Chrome, Word, Excel, etc.
*   System tray: WiFi, Volume, Battery, Time (**17:00**), Date (**14/08/2026**)

### 7. URL/Page Context
*   **URL:** `lapra08.vercel.app`
*   **Page Context:** This is the **"Program Kerja" (Work Program)** sub-section under the main **"Program & Kegiatan"** module of the LAPRA 08 internal information system. Specifically, it is showing the list for **DPD Kalimantan Barat (Regional Leadership Council of West Kalimantan)** with **60 total programs** recorded. The current view shows programs that are mostly in "Direncanakan" (Planned) status (55 out of 60).
